audience: garment fulfilment teams with Enterprise DecoNetwork Order Management API access

useCases.title: Review upcoming work
useCases.text: Find orders due in a selected date window and see their production and shipping status.

useCases.title: Inspect an order
useCases.text: Read an order by invoice number with line items, customer details, tracking and notes. Document links are omitted.

useCases.title: Search recent orders
useCases.text: Find orders by order number or date filters, then review compact summaries.

useCases.title: Mark confirmed production or shipping progress
useCases.text: Mark an order, line or workflow quantity produced or shipped. Customer email is disabled unless explicitly requested.

useCases.title: Record an internal handoff note
useCases.text: Add a staff note to an order or line item. Each call adds a new note.
